questions.question: What is the function of synchronous generator?
options: Converts electrical energy into mech. energy
Converts mech. energy to elec. energy
questions.correctOption: Converts mech. energy to elec. energy
questions.explanation: A synchronous generator converts mechanical input into electrical output. The source also calls it an alternator.
explanationLines: A synchronous generator converts mechanical input into electrical output.
The source also calls it an alternator.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In synchronous machine armature winding is placed at..........
questions.explanation: The source says stator winding is armature winding. So armature winding is placed on stator.
explanationLines: The source says stator winding is armature winding.
So armature winding is placed on stator.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is the function of exciter?
questions.explanation: The exciter gives DC supply to the rotor field. This produces the main magnetic field.
explanationLines: The exciter gives DC supply to the rotor field.
This produces the main magnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What type of rotor is commonly used in synchronous machines?
questions.explanation: The source describes salient pole rotor as a common rotor type. It is one of the main synchronous machine rotors.
explanationLines: The source describes salient pole rotor as a common rotor type.
It is one of the main synchronous machine rotors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which type of rotor of synchronous generator is used in high speed operation?
questions.explanation: The source links cylindrical or non-salient rotor with high speed operation. Both names refer to the high speed rotor type.
explanationLines: The source links cylindrical or non-salient rotor with high speed operation.
Both names refer to the high speed rotor type.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which type of rotor of synchronous generator is used in low speed operation?
questions.explanation: The source links salient pole rotor with low speed operation. It has projected poles suitable for low speed machines.
explanationLines: The source links salient pole rotor with low speed operation.
It has projected poles suitable for low speed machines.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In synchronous machine stator winding is also called............
questions.explanation: The source states stator winding is armature winding. It is the winding where generated voltage is taken.
explanationLines: The source states stator winding is armature winding.
It is the winding where generated voltage is taken.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Synchronous generator is also called..............
questions.explanation: The source says synchronous generator is also known as alternator. It generates AC electrical energy.
explanationLines: The source says synchronous generator is also known as alternator.
It generates AC electrical energy.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Motor that is used as power factor improvement............
questions.explanation: The source lists synchronous motor for power factor improvement. It can operate with leading power factor.
explanationLines: The source lists synchronous motor for power factor improvement.
It can operate with leading power factor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Damper windings are present in..............
questions.explanation: The source places damper winding in salient pole rotor. It helps starting and damping in synchronous machines.
explanationLines: The source places damper winding in salient pole rotor.
It helps starting and damping in synchronous machines.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which is the exciter of a synchronous machine?
questions.explanation: The source says exciter provides DC current to field winding. So the exciter is connected with DC supply.
explanationLines: The source says exciter provides DC current to field winding.
So the exciter is connected with DC supply.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What type of machines are synchronous machines?
questions.explanation: The source starts by saying synchronous machines are AC machines. They can operate as motor or generator.
explanationLines: The source starts by saying synchronous machines are AC machines.
They can operate as motor or generator.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A synchronous machine rotates at a speed equal to ............
questions.explanation: The source defines synchronous machine by constant synchronous speed. Its rotor runs equal to synchronous speed.
explanationLines: The source defines synchronous machine by constant synchronous speed.
Its rotor runs equal to synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A synchronous generator must be driven at ............
options: constant speed equal to synchronous speed
questions.correctOption: constant speed equal to synchronous speed
questions.explanation: The source says generator rotor must be driven at synchronous speed. This keeps generated frequency correct.
explanationLines: The source says generator rotor must be driven at synchronous speed.
This keeps generated frequency correct.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Most power generating stations use ............
questions.explanation: The source says most power stations use synchronous generator. It is also called alternator.
explanationLines: The source says most power stations use synchronous generator.
It is also called alternator.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Small size alternators are not economical, so small generation may use ............
questions.explanation: The source says induction generators are used where small size is required. This is because small alternators are not economical.
explanationLines: The source says induction generators are used where small size is required.
This is because small alternators are not economical.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What are the main parts of synchronous machine?
questions.explanation: The source lists stator, rotor and exciter as main parts. These parts form the synchronous machine.
explanationLines: The source lists stator, rotor and exciter as main parts.
These parts form the synchronous machine.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The stator is the ............ part of synchronous machine.
questions.explanation: The source describes stator as stationary part. It contains yoke, core and stator winding.
explanationLines: The source describes stator as stationary part.
It contains yoke, core and stator winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which part protects the inner part of synchronous machine?
questions.explanation: The source says yoke is the outer body. It protects and supports the inner parts.
explanationLines: The source says yoke is the outer body.
It protects and supports the inner parts.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The stator core is made of steel alloy and has ............
questions.explanation: The source says stator core has slots on its periphery. These slots accommodate stator winding.
explanationLines: The source says stator core has slots on its periphery.
These slots accommodate stator winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Why is stator core laminated?
questions.explanation: The source says stator core is laminated by thin sheets. This reduces eddy current loss.
explanationLines: The source says stator core is laminated by thin sheets.
This reduces eddy current loss.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Why is silicon steel used in stator core?
questions.explanation: The source says silicon steel reduces hysteresis loss. It improves magnetic core performance.
explanationLines: The source says silicon steel reduces hysteresis loss.
It improves magnetic core performance.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which winding is placed on rotor of synchronous machine?
questions.explanation: In synchronous machine, rotor carries field winding. The exciter supplies DC to this winding.
explanationLines: In synchronous machine, rotor carries field winding.
The exciter supplies DC to this winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor has projected poles?
questions.explanation: The source explains salient pole rotor with projected poles. It is used for low speed machines.
explanationLines: The source explains salient pole rotor with projected poles.
It is used for low speed machines.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rotor has smooth cylindrical shape?
questions.explanation: The source contrasts cylindrical and salient pole rotors. Cylindrical rotor is a non-salient type.
explanationLines: The source contrasts cylindrical and salient pole rotors.
Cylindrical rotor is a non-salient type.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The operating principle of synchronous generator is based on ............
questions.explanation: The source describes synchronous machine as generator using induction. Changing flux linkage induces emf in stator winding.
explanationLines: The source describes synchronous machine as generator using induction.
Changing flux linkage induces emf in stator winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In synchronous generator, DC field is given to ............
questions.explanation: The exciter supplies DC to rotor field winding. Rotor field produces magnetic flux.
explanationLines: The exciter supplies DC to rotor field winding.
Rotor field produces magnetic flux.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: When rotor field cuts stator conductors, it induces ............
questions.explanation: The source explains generator action by flux cutting stator conductors. This produces generated voltage.
explanationLines: The source explains generator action by flux cutting stator conductors.
This produces generated voltage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The EMF equation of synchronous generator includes ............
questions.explanation: The source gives emf equation using flux per pole. Generated emf depends on flux, turns and frequency.
explanationLines: The source gives emf equation using flux per pole.
Generated emf depends on flux, turns and frequency.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Generated EMF of alternator increases if frequency ............
questions.explanation: The EMF equation includes frequency. Higher frequency gives higher induced emf for same flux and turns.
explanationLines: The EMF equation includes frequency.
Higher frequency gives higher induced emf for same flux and turns.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Generated EMF of alternator increases if number of turns ............
questions.explanation: The source EMF equation includes number of turns. More turns produce more induced voltage.
explanationLines: The source EMF equation includes number of turns.
More turns produce more induced voltage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which factor affects magnitude of emf in synchronous generator?
questions.explanation: The source lists factors affecting generated emf. Winding factor affects the actual generated voltage.
explanationLines: The source lists factors affecting generated emf.
Winding factor affects the actual generated voltage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Terminal voltage is the voltage available at ............
questions.explanation: The source discusses relation between internal emf and terminal voltage. Terminal voltage is measured at output terminals.
explanationLines: The source discusses relation between internal emf and terminal voltage.
Terminal voltage is measured at output terminals.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Internal emf is generated ............ terminal voltage drop effects.
questions.explanation: The source relates internal emf with terminal voltage. Voltage drops inside the machine affect terminal voltage.
explanationLines: The source relates internal emf with terminal voltage.
Voltage drops inside the machine affect terminal voltage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Parallel operation of alternators means connecting alternators ............
questions.explanation: The source describes parallel operation of alternators. Alternators supply load together on common bus-bars.
explanationLines: The source describes parallel operation of alternators.
Alternators supply load together on common bus-bars.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: One reason for parallel operation of alternators is ............
questions.explanation: The source lists reasons for parallel operation. More than one alternator improves supply reliability.
explanationLines: The source lists reasons for parallel operation.
More than one alternator improves supply reliability.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Another reason for parallel operation is ............
questions.explanation: Parallel alternators can divide the connected load. This helps operate stations efficiently.
explanationLines: Parallel alternators can divide the connected load.
This helps operate stations efficiently.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Before connecting alternators in parallel, their terminal voltage must be ............
questions.explanation: The source lists same voltage as a parallel operation requirement. Voltage mismatch can cause circulating current.
explanationLines: The source lists same voltage as a parallel operation requirement.
Voltage mismatch can cause circulating current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Before parallel operation, frequency must be ............
questions.explanation: The source lists same frequency as a requirement. Different frequency prevents proper synchronization.
explanationLines: The source lists same frequency as a requirement.
Different frequency prevents proper synchronization.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Before parallel operation, phase sequence must be ............
questions.explanation: The source includes phase sequence in synchronization requirements. Wrong phase sequence causes incorrect phase connection.
explanationLines: The source includes phase sequence in synchronization requirements.
Wrong phase sequence causes incorrect phase connection.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Before parallel operation, phase angle should be ............
questions.explanation: The source includes phase agreement for synchronization. The incoming alternator must be in phase with bus-bars.
explanationLines: The source includes phase agreement for synchronization.
The incoming alternator must be in phase with bus-bars.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which is a method of synchronization?
questions.explanation: The source lists lamp methods for synchronization. Dark lamp method uses lamps to indicate synchronism.
explanationLines: The source lists lamp methods for synchronization.
Dark lamp method uses lamps to indicate synchronism.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which instrument can be used for synchronization?
questions.explanation: The source includes synchroscope method. It shows whether incoming alternator is fast or slow.
explanationLines: The source includes synchroscope method.
It shows whether incoming alternator is fast or slow.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A synchronous motor converts ............
options: mechanical energy into electrical energy only
questions.explanation: The source discusses synchronous motor operation. It is the motor form of synchronous machine.
explanationLines: The source discusses synchronous motor operation.
It is the motor form of synchronous machine.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Why is synchronous motor not self-starting?
questions.explanation: The source explains that rotor cannot start by itself from standstill. A starting method is needed for synchronous motor.
explanationLines: The source explains that rotor cannot start by itself from standstill.
A starting method is needed for synchronous motor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which winding helps a synchronous motor start?
questions.explanation: The source discusses damper winding in synchronous motor starting. It helps the motor start like an induction motor.
explanationLines: The source discusses damper winding in synchronous motor starting.
It helps the motor start like an induction motor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Synchronous motor runs at ............
questions.explanation: By definition it runs at synchronous speed. The source says synchronous machine rotates at constant synchronous speed.
explanationLines: By definition it runs at synchronous speed.
The source says synchronous machine rotates at constant synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which application is given for synchronous motor?
questions.explanation: The source lists synchronous motor for power factor improvement. It can correct poor power factor.
explanationLines: The source lists synchronous motor for power factor improvement.
It can correct poor power factor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Synchronous motor is different from three phase induction motor because it runs at ............
questions.explanation: The source compares synchronous motor and induction motor. Induction motor normally runs below synchronous speed.
explanationLines: The source compares synchronous motor and induction motor.
Induction motor normally runs below synchronous speed.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which machine is also called an alternator in this unit?
questions.explanation: The source says synchronous generator is also known as alternator. It is mainly used for AC power generation.
explanationLines: The source says synchronous generator is also known as alternator.
It is mainly used for AC power generation.
questions.subject: electrical-machine
